description: This script manages database migration and verification for a backend application. It resolves the database URL from environment variables, runs alembic migrations, and verifies the existence of key tables and seed data using psycopg2.

methods.name: str resolve_sync_url()
methods.description: Constructs and returns the database connection URL based on environment variables, handling PostgreSQL URL normalization.

methods.name: subprocess.CompletedProcess run(cmd: list, extra_env: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Executes a command as a subprocess with the given environment variables, returning the completed process.

methods.name: verify(conn)
methods.description: Connects to the database and checks for the existence of specific tables and seed data, returning a report.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Orchestrates the migration process: resolves URL, runs migrations, and performs verification.

ctags.name: run
ctags.pattern: /^def run(cmd: list, extra_env: dict | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:$/
